title: Evidence DAO
tagline: Evidence DAO is a DAO created to support DAO project delivery by providing a single place where you can find all the evidence of project delivery

prizes.placement: 🥇 IPFS — Best use of IPFS stack
prizes.title: IPFS / Filecoin

description: Evidence DAO has been created to provide projects with a way to manage all of the documentary output associated with project delivery. The idea is to provide a single easy to find and easy to use place on the decentralized internet where DAO members can find information on the delivery of approved project proposals
